examples.text: tatra sudaṃ āyasmā raṭṭhapālo thullakoṭṭhike viharati rañño korabyassa migacīre.

78102.commentary: (MNa) nimittaṃ aggahesī'ti hatthapiṭṭhiādīni olokayamānā, puttassa me raṭṭhapālassa viya suvaṇṇakacchapapiṭṭhisadisā imā hatthapādapiṭṭhiyo, haritālavaṭṭiyo viya suvaṭṭitā aṅguliyo, madhuro saro'ti gihikāle sallakkhitapubbaṃ ākāraṃ aggahesi sañjāni sallakkhesi. tassa hāyasmato dvādasavassāni araññāvāsañc'eva piṇḍiyālopabhojanañ'ca paribhuñjantassa aññādiso sarīravaṇṇo ahosi, tena naṃ sā ñātidāsī disvā'va na sañjāni, nimittaṃ pana aggahesī'ti.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa ñātidāsī taṃ ābhidosikaṃ kummāsaṃ āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa patte ākirantī hatthānañ'ca pādānañ'ca sarassa ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.
nanu, tāta raṭṭhapāla, sakaṃ gehaṃ gantabban'ti? kuto no, gahapati, amhākaṃ gehaṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ?

78104.commentary: (MNa) suvaye ṭhitā nāṭakitthiyo nikkhamitvā theraṃ parivārayiṃsu, tāsu dve jeṭṭhakitthiyo sandhāya purāṇadutiyikā'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā mahantaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇassa puñjaṃ kārāpetvā kilañjehi paṭicchādetvā āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa purāṇadutiyikā āmantesi, etha tumhe, vadhuyo, yena alaṅ'kārena alaṅ'katā pubbe raṭṭhapālassa kulaputtassa piyā hotha manāpā tena alaṅ'kārena alaṅ'karothā'ti.
khīṇaṃ purāṇaṃ navaṃ n'atthi sambhavaṃ, virattacitt'āyatike bhavasmiṃ. te khīṇabījā avirūḷhichandā, nibbanti dhīrā yath'āyaṃ padīpo.

dvi > du + tiya + ikā
dutiya + ikā

examples.text: amhākaṃ sahāyikā yakkhinī subbuṭṭhidubbuṭṭhibhāvaṃ ācikkhati, mayaṃ tassā vacanena thalesu ninnesu sassāni karoma, tena no sampajjati. kiṃ na passatha?

yathā hi mugga-māsa-ppamāṇā'pi pāsāṇasakkharā udake pakkhittā uppilavamānā nāma n'atthi, ek'antaṃ heṭṭhā'va pavisati, evam'evaṃ antamaso sakkāyadiṭṭhi'pi saggaṃ upanetuṃ samatthā nāma n'atthi, ek'antaṃ apāyesu'y'eva nimujjāpetī'ti.

78109.commentary: (ADha) sīlaṃ paripūraṇ'atthāya pana pabbajissāmī'ti vihāraṃ gacchantassa pabbajantassa manorathaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā pabbajito vat'amhi, sādhu suṭṭhū'ti āvajjantassa pātimokkhaṃ saṃvarantassa cīvar'ādayo paccaye paccavekkhantassa āpāthagatesu rūp'ādīsu cakkhudvārādīni saṃvarantassa ājīvaṃ sodhentassa ca pavattā cetanā sīlamayā nāma.

examples.text: kusalā cetanā kām'āvacarā rūp'āvacarā dānamayā sīlamayā bhāvanāmayā, ayaṃ vuccati puññ'ābhisaṅkhāro.
passa cittīkataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.

78112.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭhāpadakatā'ti ras'odakena makkhitvā nalāṭapariyante āvattanaparivatte katvā aṭṭhapadakaracanāya racitā. (THa) aṭṭhāpadakatā'ti aṭṭhapad'ākārena katā sañcitā purimabhāge kese kappetvā nalāṭassa paṭicchādanavasena katā kesaracanā aṭṭhapadaṃ nāma, yaṃ alakan'ti'pi vuccati.

examples.text: aṭṭhāpadakatā kesā, nettā añjanamakkhitā, alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.

78113.commentary: (MNa) puttapaputtakā'ti puttā ca puttaputtā cā'ti evaṃ pavattā tassa param'parā. (MNt) savaṃsavasena āgatā puttanattuādayo puttā ca paputtā ca etissā'ti puttapaputtakā param'parā.

examples.text: rañño kho pan'ānanda, maghadevassa puttapaputtakā tassa param'parā caturāsītirājasahassāni imasmiṃ'y'eva maghadevaambavane kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃsu.

78114.grammar: aor of na āsīdati, neg, trans (+acc)
78114.meaning1: (of a trap) did not trigger; did not spring

examples.text: odahi migavo pāsaṃ, n'āsadā vākaraṃ migo, bhutvā nivāpaṃ gacchāma, kandante migabandhake'ti.
atha kho rājā korabyo migavaṃ āmantesi, sodhehi, samma migava, migacīraṃ uyyānabhūmiṃ, gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyā'ti.
atha kho rājā korabyo migavaṃ āmantesi, sodhehi, samma migava, migacīraṃ uyyānabhūmiṃ, gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyā'ti.

78118.commentary: (MNa) sodhento'ti uyyānamaggaṃ samaṃ kāretvā antouyyāne tacchitabbayuttaṭṭhānāni tacchāpento sammajjitabbayuttāni ṭhānāni sammajjāpento vālukāokiraṇa-pupphavikiraṇa-puṇṇaghaṭaṭṭhapana-kadalikkhandhaṭhapan'ādīni ca karonto'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ, devā'ti kho migavo rañño korabyassa paṭissutvā migacīraṃ sodhento addasa āyasmantaṃ raṭṭhapālaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle divāvihāraṃ nisinnaṃ.

78119.commentary: (THIa) aḍḍhaṃ sīsassa olikhin'ti mayhaṃ sīsassa aḍḍham'eva muṇḍemi. keci aḍḍhaṃ sīsassa olikhin'ti kesakalāpassa aḍḍhaṃ jaṭābandhanavasena bandhitvā aḍḍhaṃ vissajjesin'ti atthaṃ vadanti.

examples.text: bahūvatasamādānā, aḍḍhaṃ sīsassa olikhiṃ, chamāya seyyaṃ kappemi, rattiṃ bhattaṃ na bhuñj'ahaṃ.
yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ katāvī, khīṇ'āsavo antimadehadhārī, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyyā'ti.

ahosiṃ ahaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, vīsativass'uddesiko'pi paṇṇavīsativass'uddesiko'pi hatthismim'pi katāvī assasmim'pi katāvī rathasmim'pi katāvī dhanusmim'pi katāvī tharusmim'pi katāvī ūrubalī bāhubalī alam'atto saṅgām'āvacaro.

78126.commentary: (DNa) evaṃ sabbattha appaṭihatañāṇo bhagavā sabbā'pi tā devatā bhabb'ābhabbavasena dve koṭṭhāse akāsi. kamm'āvaraṇena vā samannāgatā'ti-ādinā nayena vuttā sattā abhabbā nāma. te ekavihāre vasante'pi buddhā na olokenti. viparītā pana bhabbā nāma, te dūre vasante'pi gantvā saṅgaṇhanti.

examples.text: addasā kho, bhikkhave, vipassī… satte apparaj'akkhe mahāraj'akkhe tikkh'indriye mud'indriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye bhabbe abhabbe app'ekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, app'ekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.

78137.commentary: (MNa) ubhayen'eva maṃ mātali nehī'ti mātali dvīhi maggehi maṃ nehi, ahaṃ nirayaṃ passitu'kāmo devalokam'pī'ti.

examples.text: api ca, mahārāja, katamena taṃ nemi, yena vā pāpakammā pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, yena vā kalyāṇakammā kalyāṇakammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti? ubhayen'eva maṃ, mātali, nehī'ti.

78164.commentary: (VINa) yaṃ majjhimassa purisassa samantā udak'ukkhepā'ti yaṃ ṭhānaṃ majjhimassa purisassa samantato udak'ukkhepena paricchinnaṃ. kathaṃ pana udakaṃ ukkhipitabbaṃ? yathā akkhadhuttā dāruguḷaṃ khipanti, evaṃ udakaṃ vā vālikaṃ vā hatthena gahetvā thāmamajjhimena purisena sabbathāmena khipitabbaṃ. yattha evaṃ khittaṃ udakaṃ vā vālikā vā patati, ayam'eko udak'ukkhepo. tassa anto hatthapāsaṃ vijahitvā ṭhito kammaṃ kopeti. yāva parisā vaḍḍhati, tāva sīmā'pi vaḍḍhati. parisapariyantato udak'ukkhepo'y'eva pamāṇaṃ. jātassarasamuddesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: ahañ'hi pubbe hatthim'pi dhāvantaṃ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, assam'pi dhāvantaṃ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, ratham'pi dhāvantaṃ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, migam'pi dhāvantaṃ anupatitvā gaṇhāmi, atha ca pan'āhaṃ imaṃ samaṇaṃ pakatiyā gacchantaṃ sabbathāmena gacchanto na sakkomi sampāpuṇitun'ti!

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yāvañ'c'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā adantānaṃ dametā, asantānaṃ sametā, aparinibbutānaṃ parinibbāpetā.

so aparena samayena rūḷhena vaṇena sañchavinā arogo assa sukhī serī sayaṃvasī yena kāmaṅ'gamo.

78183.meaning1: place of collection; location of gathering
78183.commentary: (MNa) raj'āpathe'ti rajapathe. ayam'eva vā pāṭho, rajassa āgamanaṭṭhāne vā vuṭṭhān'uṭṭhāne vā heṭṭhāmañce vā thusakoṭṭhake vā bhājan'antare vā, yattha rajena okirīyatī'ti attho.

examples.text: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati. so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati, sambādho ghar'āvāso raj'āpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā.
sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman'ti.

78185.grammar: pron, masc dat pl of na añña, neg
78185.meaning1: not to others; not for others

examples.text: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇo gotamo evam'āha, mayham'eva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, n'āññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, mayham'eva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, n'āññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ

78186.meaning1: I am a disciple; I am a follower (of)
78186.commentary: (MNa) tassa sāvako'ham'asmī'ti tassa evaṃvividhaguṇassa satthussa ahaṃ sāvako'ti.

examples.text: dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
saddhassa, bhikkhave, sāvakassa satthusāsane pariyogāhiya vattato ayam'anudhammo hoti, satthā bhagavā, sāvako'ham'asmi, jānāti bhagavā, n'āhaṃ jānāmī'ti.

78187.grammar: imperf of saraṇaṃ āgacchati, comp vb, trans (+acc)
78187.commentary: (THa) buddhaṃ saraṇamāgaman'ti tādisena puññakammacchiddena kicchena manuss'attabhāvaṃ labhitvā idāni puññabalena buddhaṃ saraṇan'ti āgamāsiṃ, sammāsambuddho bhagavā'ti aveccapasādena satthari pasīdiṃ.

examples.text: coro ahaṃ pure āsiṃ, aṅgulimālo'ti vissuto, vuyhamāno mah'oghena, buddhaṃ saraṇam'āgamaṃ.

78188.grammar: pp of na apagacchati, in comps, neg
78188.meaning1: not wrong; not faulty; (comm) not without benefit
78188.commentary: (THa) n'āpagatan'ti na apagataṃ hit'ābhivuddhito na apetaṃ. (THa) svāgataṃ n'āpagatan'ti yaṃ tadā mama satthu santike āgataṃ āgamanaṃ, satthu vā tasmiṃ mahāvane āgamanaṃ, taṃ svāgataṃ svāgamanaṃ n'āpagataṃ, atthato apetaṃ vigataṃ na hoti.

examples.text: svāgataṃ n'āpagataṃ, na'y'idaṃ dummantitaṃ mama, saṃvibhattesu dhammesu, yaṃ seṭṭhaṃ tadupāgamaṃ.

78189.meaning1: good advice; excellent counsel; sound plan

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissā'y'eva sāvatthiyā aññatarā itthī ñātikulaṃ agamāsi. tassā te ñātakā sāmikaṃ acchinditvā aññassa dātu'kāmā. sā ca taṃ na icchati.

atha kho mallikā devī yena rājā pasenadi kosalo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ pasenadiṃ kosalaṃ etadavoca, taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, piyā te vajirī kumārī'ti? evaṃ, mallike, piyā me vajirī kumārī'ti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kāsīsu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.

78194.commentary: (MNa) ekapuṇḍarīkaṃ nāgan'ti evaṃnāmakaṃ hatthiṃ. tassa kira phāsukānaṃ upari tālaphalamattaṃ paṇḍaraṭṭhānaṃ atthi, ten'assa ekapuṇḍarīko'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo ekapuṇḍarīkaṃ nāgaṃ abhiruhitvā sāvatthiyā niyyāti divā divassa. addasā kho rājā pasenadi kosalo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ.

78195.meaning1: (of a question) to complete; to finish; to completely express
78195.meaningLit: to cause to fill all around

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! yañ'hi mayaṃ, bhante, n'āsakkhimhā pañhena paripūretuṃ taṃ, bhante, āyasmatā ānandena pañhassa veyyākaraṇena paripūritaṃ.

78197.construction: pati > paty > pacc + ā + gaccha + ti
78197.commentary: (MNa) tāni sārato paccāgaccheyyāthā'ti etāni sāran'ti evaṃsaññino hutvā paṭiāgaccheyyātha. evaṃ nissaṭṭhāni ca puna gaṇheyyāthā'ti attho.

examples.text: ye te, bhante, bālā abyattā ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā paresaṃ vaṇṇaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ vā bhāsanti, na mayaṃ taṃ sārato paccāgacchāma.

78198.meaning1: takes that as true; considers that relevant; gives that value
78198.commentary: (MNa) tāni sārato paccāgaccheyyāthā'ti etāni sāran'ti evaṃsaññino hutvā paṭiāgaccheyyātha. evaṃ nissaṭṭhāni ca puna gaṇheyyāthā'ti attho.

examples.text: ye te, bhante, bālā abyattā ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā paresaṃ vaṇṇaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ vā bhāsanti, na mayaṃ taṃ sārato paccāgacchāma, ye pana te, bhante, paṇḍitā viyattā medhāvino anuvicca pariyogāhetvā paresaṃ vaṇṇaṃ vā avaṇṇaṃ vā bhāsanti, mayaṃ taṃ sārato paccāgacchāma.
